feedback: Major previous issues are fixed: the enrollment form now presents one train step at a time with next/back controls, the child plan summary no longer overlaps content on tablet/mobile and has live-looking price states, and the contact page now uses a circular map card. Remaining minor gaps: the 768px tablet layout collapses navigation to a hamburger instead of preserving a fuller top-bar tablet treatment, some responsive screenshots show very large hero/card typography that pushes content below the fold, and the live price/tabs appear mostly CSS-driven rather than fully interactive filtering/calculation. Overall this is a strong match to the playful RTL spec.
